notes.title: 1.02.02 Bugfix
notes.content: - Crash if a player lost an alotment by the Sanitary Board (.02)(Andreas Wollstädter)

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02.01
notes.content: Bug in evaluating equipment could cause crash to desktop (.01)(Franz Fischer)

notes.title: Update to 1.02
notes.content:
Added:

- New awards: Bronce,Silver and Golden Seat for total customers
- New Loopedia article: Seat awards
- Loopedia: Added symbols to some articles to improve understanding
- New victory condition: most customer after X turns
- Loopedia: Added section about the victory conditions increasing it to 74 articles in two languages
- Statistics: Total revenue and lured customers of a match are now displayed as small table in the background of the corresponding charts

Fixed:

- Tooltip delay was at 400% by default (is now 50%)
- AI faced a situation where it pondered in circles and stopped the game from progessing (Franz Fischer)
- AI bug in equipment management
- Typos across both languages and the whole game

Changed:

- Some AI evaluations were adjusted

notes.title: Update to 1.01
notes.content:
Update 1.01 15. November 2021

Added:

- New awards: Medals of Mechanic
- New alotment for Slurry Hamlet: Foul Water Street
- New label: A matter of smell
- New Loopedia article: Medals of Mechanic
- Explanation of 'Progress bonus' in the article 'Research modes'

Fixed:

- Statistics for tidiness and function were shifted one turn 
- Several typos, clarified rules and updated images in Loopedia

Changed:

- Economic evaluation now distributes customers in more steps and thus more evenly-matched
- Progress bonus: All opponents get a 2% bonus for lower or equal research results of a tree

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.01
notes.content:
- Research mode 'Classic' could lead to crash in AI turn (.01) (Christopher Pallasch)
- Tweaked brand building bonus and gossiper values
